patch_description:
The current approach uses one pressure-first ordering and up to `len(models)` bottleneck-only move/swap repairs. Its key limitations are construction-order sensitivity and fragmentation from placing large models too late.

This version uses five deterministic construction orders: pressure-first, size-first, pressure-density-first, hard-to-place-first (`size / 80` plus density), and a large-model-priority ordering. Each start selects the GPU minimizing the resulting global maximum KVPR, then performs strict-improvement move and swap repair across all GPUs. The best feasible placement from all starts is returned. The repair iteration limit is increased to `2 * len(models)`, while accepting only improvements larger than `1e-12`, ensuring termination.
